fusions.name: Doorway Throw
fusions.desc: A thrown strike that deals 30 damage, up to 2 times as much at maximum range. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lance Thrust
fusions.desc: Thrusts in a narrow line, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Point Blank Reach
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further.

fusions.name: Aimed True
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%. Every ability you have comes round 5% sooner.
